attributes.proposal_description:
Rare Network proposes the administration of a $500,000 USD Community-Led Events Fund to support Cardano ecosystem contributors in hosting events globally. This initiative aims to position Cardano as a leader in blockchain by increasing visibility, engagement, and adoption. 

See the deck for a better understanding of the proposal: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1cpP3sNTCJV9xDVXQ4CsQ6RUi1uVXpr4C?usp=sharing

Challenges Identified
	· Lack of Cardano Events: Limited community-led events showcasing the ecosystem.
	· Insufficient Funding: Compared to competitor Layer-1 blockchains, Cardano lacks financial support for events.
	· Inefficient Funding Mechanisms: Existing structures are impractical for event production due to overhead costs and timing constraints.
	· Lack of SOPs: No standard operating procedures exist to maintain brand integrity and effective project management.

Proposed Solution
Rare Network will administer an events fund allowing community members to host, attend, and create meaningful opportunities through both in-person and virtual events. The key components include:
	· Specialized Proposal System: Ensuring equitable access to funding.
	· Diverse Budget Allocation: Providing funds between $500 and $30,000 USD for different event scales/scopes.
	· Efficient Administration: Ensuring fair distribution and transparent management.
	· Brand Integrity: Developing SOPs and brand guidelines to maintain alignment with Cardano’s values.
	· Transparent Reporting: Documenting successes, challenges, and impact.

Event Categories & Eligibility
Funding is open to individuals, organizations, and collaborations within the Cardano community. Events may include:
	· Local Meetups
	· Technical Workshops
	· Networking Socials
	· Working Groups
	· Conference Exhibitions
	· Educational Seminars

Funding Process
	1. Submit Proposal: Applications through an online portal.
	2. Review & Approval: Evaluation by Rare Network and shared with GMC/MWG for feedback.
	3. Fund Distribution: Dynamic allocation based on event type and budget needs.
	4. Close-Out Report: Recipients must provide reports, KPIs, and media documentation.

Selection Criteria
	· Regional Diversity: Supporting events across different regions.
	· Event Experience: Ensuring high-quality execution.
	· Impact: Driving innovation and engagement.
	· Resource Optimization: Ensuring effective use of funds.

Administrative Costs & Timeline
	· A 15% administration fee will cover planning, proposal management, and execution to compensate Rare Network for their efforts.
	· Funding available from July 1, 2025 – March 31, 2026.

Strategic Alignment with Cardano’s Product Roadmap
	· Ecosystem Growth: Driving global adoption and networking.
	· Developer Engagement: Fostering technical workshops and hackathons.
	· Collaboration: Aligning with the Growth & Marketing Committee (GMC), other Intersect committees, and Cardano’s founding entities.
	· Brand Strengthening: Showcasing Cardano’s innovation through impactful events.
	· Community Feedback Loop: Using events to refine strategies and improve ecosystem development.

Conclusion
Rare Network, a trusted partner within the Cardano ecosystem, has a proven track record of successfully managing community-driven initiatives. With endorsement from Intersect, GMC, Cardano Foundation, Emurgo, and IOG, this proposal ensures a sustainable, well-organized, and impactful community-led events program.

- Rare Network to deploy proposal platform and application process to the public.

- Onboard more users and builders to the Cardano ecosystem
- Catch up to speed and compete with larger, equal, and smaller market cap blockchains (even some L2s spend more than Cardano who is a leading L1) who somehow have more spend and robust events strategies in place currently than Cardano.
attributes.supplementary_endorsement:
Rare Network has been actively engaged in the Marketing Working Group since October of 2024, when we presented in collaboration with the Cardano Foundation at the Cardano Summit 2024 on an events strategy for 2025/2026. The presentation focused around collaboration between the founding entity marketing/events teams and ourselves, as the trusted/preferred community events production vendor. 

The presentation evolved into a separate effort of fostering support to transcend the Marketing Working Group (MWG) operating under the MCC into it's own separate council, now known as the Growth & Marketing Committee (GMC). Rare Network, along with the MWG, Emurgo, Cardano Foundation, and Input Output, were instrumental in co-founding the GMC. 

Rare Network through the course of nearly a half year, campaigned on behalf of the MWG and it's constituents to bring the GMC to a reality. This was accomplished by nearly 30 half hour to full hour presentations and 12 versions of refinement based on feedback from these meetings of our original deck. These sessions took place with members of the Cardano community worldwide from experienced events hosts and marketers, to organizations, to dReps, to Intersect members, to founding entity leads, and all others in between. 

Presentations can be found from events like GM Cardano: 
https://www.youtube.com/live/Yk3-fW5PzuE?si=npF9dcoBGaN7RMDa&t=18816 

(latest presentation for reference on co-founding GMC (pre-budget finalization): https://acrobat.adobe.com/id/urn:aaid:sc:VA6C2:306c06ec-6996-4092-bcd4-4465c4e22b06)

Upon official formation of the GMC and completion of our charter, our efforts were geared towards establishing a proper events and marketing strategy, along with a budget. The group went through many more renditions and ultimately came to a finalized version that will help cover us for the remainder of 2025 and for events, down payments into 2026 to improve cost efficiency, maintain momentum/pace, and proper resource planning. 

With this background in mind, it is evident that we have the endorsement as a preferred services vendor by Intersect, the GMC operating within it, Cardano Foundation, Emurgo, and Input Output Global, along with this support remaining consistent throughout greater Cardano community's sentiment.
attributes.explain_proposal_roadmap:
Our proposal directly supports the Product Roadmap by fostering community-led engagement, increasing awareness, and strengthening the overall brand of Cardano. Through the Community-Led Events Fund, we empower ecosystem contributors and projects to host impactful events that align with Cardano’s strategic direction.

Alignment with the Product Roadmap:

Ecosystem Growth & Adoption – By funding and supporting grassroots events, we increase user adoption, onboard new developers, and create networking opportunities that fuel ecosystem expansion.

Developer & Builder Engagement – Events will provide hands-on experiences, workshops, and hackathons that encourage developers to build on Cardano, ultimately contributing to the success of key product milestones.

Collaboration with Key Stakeholders – Our active coordination with the GMC, Product Committee, and Cardano’s Founding Entities ensures alignment with broader product goals and strategic initiatives.

Strengthening Cardano’s Brand – Hosting well-executed events helps promote Cardano’s vision, technological advancements, and community-driven innovations, solidifying its reputation in the blockchain industry.

Feedback Loop for Product Development – Events serve as a direct channel for community feedback, allowing teams to refine product strategies, enhance usability, and address market needs effectively.

By leveraging our trusted position within the Cardano ecosystem and maintaining close collaboration with governance bodies, our initiative ensures that community-led events contribute meaningfully to the roadmap’s execution.

attributes.proposal_description:
Rare Network proposes the administration of a $500,000 USD Community-Led Events Fund to support Cardano ecosystem contributors in hosting events globally. This initiative aims to position Cardano as a leader in blockchain by increasing visibility, engagement, and adoption.

Challenges Identified
	· Lack of Cardano Events: Limited community-led events showcasing the ecosystem.
	· Insufficient Funding: Compared to competitor Layer-1 blockchains, Cardano lacks financial support for events.
	· Inefficient Funding Mechanisms: Existing structures are impractical for event production due to overhead costs and timing constraints.
	· Lack of SOPs: No standard operating procedures exist to maintain brand integrity and effective project management.

Proposed Solution
Rare Network will administer an events fund allowing community members to host, attend, and create meaningful opportunities through both in-person and virtual events. The key components include:
	· Specialized Proposal System: Ensuring equitable access to funding.
	· Diverse Budget Allocation: Providing funds between $500 and $30,000 USD for different event scales/scopes.
	· Efficient Administration: Ensuring fair distribution and transparent management.
	· Brand Integrity: Developing SOPs and brand guidelines to maintain alignment with Cardano’s values.
	· Transparent Reporting: Documenting successes, challenges, and impact.

Event Categories & Eligibility
Funding is open to individuals, organizations, and collaborations within the Cardano community. Events may include:
	· Local Meetups
	· Technical Workshops
	· Networking Socials
	· Working Groups
	· Conference Exhibitions
	· Educational Seminars

Funding Process
	1. Submit Proposal: Applications through an online portal.
	2. Review & Approval: Evaluation by Rare Network and shared with GMC/MWG for feedback.
	3. Fund Distribution: Dynamic allocation based on event type and budget needs.
	4. Close-Out Report: Recipients must provide reports, KPIs, and media documentation.

Selection Criteria
	· Regional Diversity: Supporting events across different regions.
	· Event Experience: Ensuring high-quality execution.
	· Impact: Driving innovation and engagement.
	· Resource Optimization: Ensuring effective use of funds.

Administrative Costs & Timeline
	· A 15% administration fee will cover planning, proposal management, and execution to compensate Rare Network for their efforts.
	· Funding available from July 1, 2025 – March 31, 2026.

Strategic Alignment with Cardano’s Product Roadmap
	· Ecosystem Growth: Driving global adoption and networking.
	· Developer Engagement: Fostering technical workshops and hackathons.
	· Collaboration: Aligning with the Growth & Marketing Committee (GMC), other Intersect committees, and Cardano’s founding entities.
	· Brand Strengthening: Showcasing Cardano’s innovation through impactful events.
	· Community Feedback Loop: Using events to refine strategies and improve ecosystem development.

Conclusion
Rare Network, a trusted partner within the Cardano ecosystem, has a proven track record of successfully managing community-driven initiatives. With endorsement from Intersect, GMC, Cardano Foundation, Emurgo, and IOG, this proposal ensures a sustainable, well-organized, and impactful community-led events program.

attributes.proposal_description:
Rare Network proposes the administration of a $500,000 USD Community-Led Events Fund to support Cardano ecosystem contributors in hosting events globally. This initiative aims to position Cardano as a leader in blockchain by increasing visibility, engagement, and adoption.

Challenges Identified
	· Lack of Cardano Events: Limited community-led events showcasing the ecosystem.
	· Insufficient Funding: Compared to competitor Layer-1 blockchains, Cardano lacks financial support for events.
	· Inefficient Funding Mechanisms: Existing structures are impractical for event production due to overhead costs and timing constraints.
	· Lack of SOPs: No standard operating procedures exist to maintain brand integrity and effective project management.

Proposed Solution
Rare Network will administer an events fund allowing community members to host, attend, and create meaningful opportunities through both in-person and virtual events. The key components include:
	· Specialized Proposal System: Ensuring equitable access to funding.
	· Diverse Budget Allocation: Providing funds between $500 and $30,000 USD for different event scales/scopes.
	· Efficient Administration: Ensuring fair distribution and transparent management.
	· Brand Integrity: Developing SOPs and brand guidelines to maintain alignment with Cardano’s values.
	· Transparent Reporting: Documenting successes, challenges, and impact.

Event Categories & Eligibility
Funding is open to individuals, organizations, and collaborations within the Cardano community. Events may include:
	· Local Meetups
	· Technical Workshops
	· Networking Socials
	· Working Groups
	· Conference Exhibitions
	· Educational Seminars

Funding Process
	1. Submit Proposal: Applications through an online portal.
	2. Review & Approval: Evaluation by Rare Network and shared with GMC/MWG for feedback.
	3. Fund Distribution: Dynamic allocation based on event type and budget needs.
	4. Close-Out Report: Recipients must provide reports, KPIs, and media documentation.

Selection Criteria
	· Regional Diversity: Supporting events across different regions.
	· Event Experience: Ensuring high-quality execution.
	· Impact: Driving innovation and engagement.
	· Resource Optimization: Ensuring effective use of funds.

Administrative Costs & Timeline
	· A 15% administration fee will cover planning, proposal management, and execution to compensate Rare Network for their efforts.
	· Funding available from July 1, 2025 – March 31, 2026.

Strategic Alignment with Cardano’s Product Roadmap
	· Ecosystem Growth: Driving global adoption and networking.
	· Developer Engagement: Fostering technical workshops and hackathons.
	· Collaboration: Aligning with the Growth & Marketing Committee (GMC), other Intersect committees, and Cardano’s founding entities.
	· Brand Strengthening: Showcasing Cardano’s innovation through impactful events.
	· Community Feedback Loop: Using events to refine strategies and improve ecosystem development.

Conclusion
Rare Network, a trusted partner within the Cardano ecosystem, has a proven track record of successfully managing community-driven initiatives. With endorsement from Intersect, GMC, Cardano Foundation, Emurgo, and IOG, this proposal ensures a sustainable, well-organized, and impactful community-led events program.

attributes.proposal_description:
Rare Network proposes the administration of a $500,000 USD Community-Led Events Fund to support Cardano ecosystem contributors in hosting events globally. This initiative aims to position Cardano as a leader in blockchain by increasing visibility, engagement, and adoption.

Challenges Identified
	· Lack of Cardano Events: Limited community-led events showcasing the ecosystem.
	· Insufficient Funding: Compared to competitor Layer-1 blockchains, Cardano lacks financial support for events.
	· Inefficient Funding Mechanisms: Existing structures are impractical for event production due to overhead costs and timing constraints.
	· Lack of SOPs: No standard operating procedures exist to maintain brand integrity and effective project management.

Proposed Solution
Rare Network will administer an events fund allowing community members to host, attend, and create meaningful opportunities through both in-person and virtual events. The key components include:
	· Specialized Proposal System: Ensuring equitable access to funding.
	· Diverse Budget Allocation: Providing funds between $500 and $30,000 USD for different event scales/scopes.
	· Efficient Administration: Ensuring fair distribution and transparent management.
	· Brand Integrity: Developing SOPs and brand guidelines to maintain alignment with Cardano’s values.
	· Transparent Reporting: Documenting successes, challenges, and impact.

Event Categories & Eligibility
Funding is open to individuals, organizations, and collaborations within the Cardano community. Events may include:
	· Local Meetups
	· Technical Workshops
	· Networking Socials
	· Working Groups
	· Conference Exhibitions
	· Educational Seminars

Funding Process
	1. Submit Proposal: Applications through an online portal.
	2. Review & Approval: Evaluation by Rare Network and shared with GMC/MWG for feedback.
	3. Fund Distribution: Dynamic allocation based on event type and budget needs.
	4. Close-Out Report: Recipients must provide reports, KPIs, and media documentation.

Selection Criteria
	· Regional Diversity: Supporting events across different regions.
	· Event Experience: Ensuring high-quality execution.
	· Impact: Driving innovation and engagement.
	· Resource Optimization: Ensuring effective use of funds.

Administrative Costs & Timeline
	· A 15% administration fee will cover planning, proposal management, and execution to compensate Rare Network for their efforts.
	· Funding available from July 1, 2025 – March 31, 2026.

Strategic Alignment with Cardano’s Product Roadmap
	· Ecosystem Growth: Driving global adoption and networking.
	· Developer Engagement: Fostering technical workshops and hackathons.
	· Collaboration: Aligning with the Growth & Marketing Committee (GMC), other Intersect committees, and Cardano’s founding entities.
	· Brand Strengthening: Showcasing Cardano’s innovation through impactful events.
	· Community Feedback Loop: Using events to refine strategies and improve ecosystem development.

Conclusion
Rare Network, a trusted partner within the Cardano ecosystem, has a proven track record of successfully managing community-driven initiatives. With endorsement from Intersect, GMC, Cardano Foundation, Emurgo, and IOG, this proposal ensures a sustainable, well-organized, and impactful community-led events program.
